svg.data-weight: 6.65 kg with no supply, fan or extension module (EX4400-48F); -AFI 6.94 kg, -DC and -DC-AFI 6.89 kg, -S 5.8 kg
svg.data-depth-with-modules: 430.0 mm with power supply and fan modules; 440.7 mm with an extension module as well
svg.data-mounting: two-post kit EX-RMK in the box; four-post kit EX-4PST-RMK and wall kit EX-WMK separate
svg.data-heat-dissipation: 388.74 BTU/hr idle and 412.61 at 100 percent traffic with a 550 W AC supply; 429.66 and 453.53 with a 550 W DC supply
svg.data-operating-temp: 0 C to 45 C (32 F to 113 F)
svg.data-storage-temp: -40 C to 70 C (-40 F to 158 F) in the shipping container
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation up to 1828.8 m (6000 ft) at 40 C
svg.data-acoustic-noise: 43.23 dB(A) typical with one 550 W AC supply and front-to-back airflow (Table 115)
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches over the QSFP28 ports, which are Virtual Chassis ports by default
svg.data-macsec: AES-256 on all SFP and SFP+ network ports and the SFP28 and QSFP28 extension module ports
svg.data-optics-sfp: 100 Mbps and 1 GbE SFP transceivers on ports 0 to 35; 1G SFP-T copper transceivers take 10, 100 and 1000 Mbps
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: 10 GbE SFP+ and 1 GbE SFP transceivers on ports 36 to 47; the exact list is in the Hardware Compatibility Tool
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: The two rear ports take 100GbE QSFP28 or 40GbE QSFP+ transceivers (40G from Junos OS 22.1R1). Breakout cables give 4x25G and 4x10G. The exact list is in the Hardware Compatibility Tool
svg.data-qsfp28-channelization: each QSFP28 port runs as 100G, as 40G from Junos OS 22.1R1, or channelized
svg.data-extension-slot: one slot for the EX4400-EM-4S, EX4400-EM-4Y or EX4400-EM-1C module
svg.data-console: USB-C on the front and RJ-45 (CON) on the rear
svg.data-oob: MGMT RJ-45 on the rear, 10/100/1000, with link activity and status lamps
svg.data-cloud: Juniper Mist Wired Assurance, and the Junos CLI and J-Web
svg.data-seismic: Tested for Zone 4 earthquake according to NEBS GR-63-CORE, Issue 5

g.data-description: Table 41 - green steady: Junos OS is loaded; green blinking: the switch is booting; unlit: powered off or halted
g.title: led-sys

g.data-description: Table 41 - red: major hardware fault and the switch is halted; amber: minor alarm; unlit: no alarm or halted
g.title: led-alm

g.data-description: Table 41 - standalone switch: green steady is normal, unlit is powered off or halted. Virtual Chassis: green steady primary, green blinking backup, unlit linecard member
g.title: led-mst

g.data-description: Cloud connection lamp, enabled in Junos OS 21.2R1. The blink patterns are not in this guide
g.title: led-cld

g.data-description: Table 44 - port mode lamp; lit shows the speed of the network ports. SFP ports: steady 1000 Mbps, blinking 100 Mbps. SFP+ ports: steady 10 Gbps, blinking 1000 Mbps
g.title: led-spd

g.data-description: Table 44 - port mode lamp; lit shows full duplex, unlit half duplex
g.title: led-dx

g.data-description: Table 44 - port mode lamp; lit shows ports administratively enabled, unlit disabled
g.title: led-en
